sections.Profile:
"Sea Shore" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in September 1964. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, the game features two flippers, four pop bumpers, four passive bumpers, two slingshots, three standup targets, two roto-targets, and two kick-out holes.
